gaps: Frost/hoar deposition per night: only Hachikubo and Akitaya 1997 (JGR 102 D4) found, whose extracted text is garbled (spaces stripped), and Stossel 2010 and the 2026 Cryosphere preprint were not retrievable/read; no verified frost row.
Dew on undersides versus top faces (downward-facing surfaces, sky view factor): no measured comparison found.

Fraction of condensed dew collected by gravity as a function of tilt and wettability for outdoor condensers: only qualitative (UCLA 2026 slippery film, leaf chamber); Drexel wettability/tilt paper and Beysens book (Springer 2022) were not opened.
Persistence of dew after sunrise on roofs/foils/large smooth surfaces: only vegetation data (about 4 h after sunrise, shrubs); no condenser or roof figure found.

Muselli/Nilsson/Tomaszkiewicz specific nightly yields: Water Supply 2022 Brazil OPUR comparison (0.151 mm) seen only in a search snippet (doaj blocked), not verified; Meunier Dew, fog, drizzle chapter and HAL pages blocked, unread.
Latent heat 2.45 MJ/kg arithmetic: not printed in any verified source here; 100 W/m2 and 0.8 L/m2/night are given separately, not as one derivation.
Dew suppression above 3-4.5 m/s: verified only as 3 m/s (Ajaccio planar) and about 4 m/s at 10 m (Croatia); 4.5 m/s not found.
